articles.title: Copy the expected, but build what you need.
articles.excerpt: For the last year I've been working on an app called Glimpse. It's a dictation app and a meeting app, built pretty much all by myself. I want to share something I've learned about building apps like t…
articles.body: For the last year I've been working on an app called Glimpse . It's a dictation app and a meeting app, built pretty much all by myself. I want to share something I've learned about building apps like this, where people come in with expectations, and how to build something that sets you apart. After spending a few months getting Glimpse to have every feature anyone would expect in a dictation app, I wanted to look at meetings, since they could be built on the same models and interfaces. One of my big inspirations there was MacWhisper. After I'd released a working meeting mode, I got an email from them about a new feature they'd launched called live transcripts. I thought it was cool, so I built it in. The important part is that I used it. I noticed what I didn't like about it.

articles.title: Guardrail para la abogacía
articles.excerpt: Respuesta corta Un guardrail para la abogacía es un conjunto de controles técnicos y éticos que limitan el uso de IA en servicios jurídicos, asegurando conformidad con el Estatuto de la OAB, la Ley 8.…
articles.body: Respuesta corta Un guardrail para la abogacía es un conjunto de controles técnicos y éticos que limitan el uso de IA en servicios jurídicos, asegurando conformidad con el Estatuto de la OAB, la Ley 8.906/1994 y los principios de independencia profesional, secreto profesional y responsabilidad personal del abogado. TL;DR La OAB exige que toda asistencia basada en IA sea supervisada directamente por un abogado inscrito, sin delegación de funciones esenciales (Parecer OAB/SP n.º 152/2023). El uso de modelos de lenguaje generativo en asesoramiento jurídico requiere verificación humana previa a la emisión de opinión o documento (Resolución OAB n.º 03/2024).

articles.excerpt: After months of speculation, Rockstar finally revealed that GTA 6 would be targeting 30 fps on all of the current-generation consoles, including the Xbox Series S. But, thanks to a cloud streaming dea…
articles.body: After months of speculation, Rockstar finally revealed that GTA 6 would be targeting 30 fps on all of the current-generation consoles , including the Xbox Series S . But, thanks to a cloud streaming deal with Xbox, you can technically play the game on the Xbox One. While GTA 6 will only be running locally on the PS5 and Xbox Series consoles, Rockstar finally detailed which devices will be able to use Xbox Cloud Gaming to play the game. Its blog post says "The game will also be available via Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles, utilizing Xbox Series S graphics settings." So, you can technically play GTA 6 on the Xbox One, which launched all the way back in 2013, it just won't be, well, running on the Xbox One itself.

articles.body: For those who want to experience a total solar eclipse, the next two years present the best kind of problem. On Aug. 2, 2027, the so-called "eclipse of the century " will sweep across southern Spain, North Africa and the Middle East, bringing more than six minutes of totality to parts of Egypt. Then, on July 22, 2028, another exceptionally long total solar eclipse will cross Australia, putting the remote Outback and Sydney Harbor in the path of the moon's dark central shadow before it reaches New Zealand's beautiful South Island. Both eclipses will be spectacular, and both will require careful planning, yet they promise very different experiences.

articles.title: NASA's twin ESCAPADE Mars probes slingshot around Earth in unprecedented double 'gravity assist'
articles.excerpt: NASA's twin ESCAPADE spacecraft are wrapping up a year-long voyage to Mars, and are now ready to make a beeline to the Red Planet.
articles.body: Twin NASA spacecraft are wrapping up a year-long escapade, ready to make a beeline to the Red Planet. The Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers (ESCAPADE) spacecraft launched in November 2025 on the second-ever flight of Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket. But rather than head straight to Mars, the two spacecraft dawdled through a looping trajectory . Now, they are back in Earth's neighborhood where they tackled a crucial engine burn unusually close to Earth that — if all goes well — will set them on track for Mars . "No NASA mission has ever done this before," said Rob Lillis, a planetary and space physicist at the University of California, Berkeley and principal investigator of the ESCAPADE mission.
